fact: A 2025 master's thesis says Somalia's RAAD EHR and the national DHIS2 are connected, with RAAD pushing monthly summaries to DHIS2 through a point-to-point adapter at each clinic.
title: The Future of Somali Health-care IT: Configuring DHIS2 and RAAD for Scalable and Interoperable Healthcare IT
publisher: Stockholm University, Department of Computer and Systems Sciences
